name: work-helper
description: Project and git branch in the status line; a band with the project's task queue, usage limits, context fill, token cost and time today; budget alerts, a done ping, a Docker pane; add-task and hours skills

showProject.title: Status line: project
showProject.description: Show the current project and git branch in the status line

showTasks.title: Task queue
showTasks.description: Per-project task queue: band rows, task tools and the add-task skill's tools

showLimits.title: Usage limits
showLimits.description: 5-hour and weekly usage-left bars in the band

showContext.title: Context meter
showContext.description: Context window fill bar in the band

showCost.title: Token cost
showCost.description: Session token cost at API prices in the band

trackTime.title: Time tracker
trackTime.description: Track active time per project per day; /time, time_report tool and the hours skill

dockerPane.title: Docker pane
dockerPane.description: /docker opens a pane with the project's containers and start / stop buttons

budgetAlerts.title: Budget alerts
budgetAlerts.description: Toast and notify when limits, cost or context cross a threshold

costStepUsd.title: Cost alert step ($)
costStepUsd.description: Alert each time the session's token cost passes another multiple of this

limitAlertPercent.title: Limit alert (%)
limitAlertPercent.description: Alert when the 5-hour or weekly window passes this much used (and at 95%)

contextAlertPercent.title: Context alert (%)
contextAlertPercent.description: Alert when the context window is this full

donePing.title: Done ping
donePing.description: Desktop notification when a long turn finishes

doneAfterSeconds.title: Done ping after (s)
doneAfterSeconds.description: Only notify for turns at least this long
